name: J1939Tp
description: Configuration of the J1939Tp (J1939 Transport Protocol) module.

children.name: J1939TpConfiguration
children.description: This container contains the configuration parameters and sub containers of the J1939Tp module that define the communication paths.

children.name: J1939TpRxChannel
children.description: This container describes a reception channel of the J1939Tp module. A channel referencing N-PDUs without MetaData is used for all N-SDUs that share the same source address (SA) and the same destination address (BAM: DA = 0xFF, CMDT: DA != 0xFF). A channel with N-PDUs with MetaData is used for all possible source and destination addresses.

children.name: J1939TpRxCancellationSupport
children.description: Enable receive cancellation using the API J1939Tp_CancelReceive() for this channel.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: J1939TpRxDa
children.description: Destination address (DA) of this channel. This parameter is only required for channels with fixed DA which use N-PDUs with MetaData containing the DA.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: POST-BUILD VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: POST-BUILD VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: J1939TpRxDynamicBlockCalculation
children.description: Enable dynamic calculation of "number of packets that can be sent" value in TP.CM_CTS, based on the size of buffers in upper layers reported via StartOfReception and PduR_J1939TpCopyRxData.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: J1939TpRxDynamicBufferRatio
children.description: Percentage of available buffer that shall be used for retry.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter is only applicable when "J1939TpRxRetrySupport" and "J1939TpRxDynamicBlockCalculation" are enabled.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: J1939TpRxPacketsPerBlock
children.description: Number of TP.DT frames the receiving J1939Tp module allows the sender to send before waiting for another TP.CM_CTS. This parameter is transmitted in the TP.CM_CTS frame, and is thus only relevant for reception of messages via CMDT. When J1939TpRxDynamicBlockCalculation is enabled, this parameter specifies a maximum for the calculated value. For further details on this parameter value see SAE J1939/21.

children.name: J1939TpRxProtocolType
children.description: Protocol type used by this channel. This parameter is only required for channels with fixed destination address.

children.name: J1939TpRxRetrySupport
children.description: Enable support for triggering repetition of failed transmission using TP.CM_CTS with a packet number that has already been sent. Retransmission is triggered when a sequence number is missing or a timeout occurs during reception.

children.name: J1939TpRxSa
children.description: Source address (SA) of this channel. This parameter is only required for channels with fixed SA which use N-PDUs with MetaData.

children.description: This N-PDU represents the TP.CM frame of a J1939 transport protocol session. TP.CM is used both by BAM and CMDT to initialize the connection. For CMDT, it is also used to abort the connection.

children.description: The N-PDU identifier used for communication with CanIf.

children.description: The N-PDU identifier used for communication with CanIf.

children.description: This flag is set to TRUE when the N-SDU refers to a PGN with variable length.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Please note: When this attribute is TRUE, the sub container J1939TpRxDirectNPdu is required.

children.description: This N-PDU represents the TP.CM frame that is used in reverse direction for a J1939 transport protocol session using the CMDT protocol type. TP.CM in reverse direction is used for intermediate and final acknowledgement of received data and to abort the connection.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Please note: This sub container is only required when J1939TpRxProtocolType is J1939TP_PROTOCOL_CMDT or when it is not configured at all.

children.description: This container describes the general configuration parameters of the J1939Tp module.

children.description: Enable transmit and receive cancellation.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The APIs J1939Tp_CancelTransmit() and J1939Tp_CancelReceive() will only be available when this parameter is enabled.

children.name: J1939TpMainFunctionPeriod
children.description: Allow to configure the time for the MainFunction (in seconds).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Please note: This configuration value shall be equal to the value in the ScheduleManager module.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: J1939TpTxConfTimeout
children.description: Timeout in seconds for the CanIf Tx confirmation. After this time the J1939Tp assumes that an N-PDU could not be transmitted.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Please note: The Tx confirmation timeout should be set to a value that enabled detection of a lost Tx confirmation in time, and that ensures that normal transmission delay caused by lower message priority does not lead to an error.
